ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a skeletal structure, with a benzene ring on the left; the right side of the benzene ring is connected to a nitrogen atom bearing hydrogen, N-H, and electron dots and an arrow are also drawn on the nitrogen. The nitrogen atom is connected toward the upper right to a three-carbon chain, and the end of the chain is a carbon connected by a double bond to oxygen; this oxygen is also connected to hydrogen and is labeled with a positive charge. There are curved arrows in the figure, but the problem asks to ignore the arrows. Reasoning: Encode according to the skeletal connectivity, starting from the protonated carbonyl end, the oxygen bears hydrogen and a positive charge and is connected to the carbon by a double bond, written as [OH+]=C; continuing from this carbon along the three-carbon chain to the nitrogen gives [OH+]=CCC; the nitrogen bears hydrogen and is connected to the benzene ring, and the benzene ring is written as c1ccccc1, so the terminus is Nc1ccccc1. Combining gives the SMILES: [OH+]=CCCNc1ccccc1.

method.method_draft: Inspect the image as a skeletal structure, not as a mechanism: ignore all curved arrows and electron-pair dots. Starting from the protonated carbonyl end, encode the O-H atom with positive charge double-bonded to carbon as [OH+]=C. Continue along the three-carbon chain from that carbon toward nitrogen as [OH+]=CCC. Then attach the N-H connected to the phenyl ring, giving N c1ccccc1. Concatenate the observed connectivity to obtain [OH+]=CCCNc1ccccc1.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个骨架式结构，左侧为苯环；苯环右侧连接一个带氢的氮原子 N-H，氮上还画有电子点和箭头。氮原子向右上连接一条三碳链，链的末端是一个与氧双键相连的碳；该氧还连接氢并标有正电荷。图中有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：按骨架连接关系编码，从质子化羰基端开始，氧带氢并带正电且与碳双键相连，写作 [OH+]=C；从该碳继续沿三碳链到氮，得到 [OH+]=CCC；氮带氢并连接苯环，苯环写作 c1ccccc1，因此末端为 Nc1ccccc1。合并得到 SMILES：[OH+]=CCCNc1ccccc1。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the drawn connectivity while ignoring curved arrows: a benzene ring bonded to an exocyclic N bearing H; that N is bonded to a three-carbon chain; the terminal carbon is double-bonded to an oxygen that also bears H and a positive charge.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the desired output is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard SMILES rules: benzene can be written as c1ccccc1, an anilino nitrogen as Nc1ccccc1, single-bond aliphatic carbons as C-C-C, and a protonated oxonium carbonyl as [OH+]=C. Combine fragments according to the observed connectivity.
